root_idea.summary: The root centers on blazing, pure flame and fiery intensity, with a related nominal development for blazing fire and Hell.
root_idea.development: The lexical field moves from the flame itself and the act of blazing to the conventional name لَظَىٰ for Hell.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested verbal form describing fire that blazes.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used of fire that blazes or flames up; the form is intransitive.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal use for the flame itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lazā, a proper name for Hell.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An indeclinable proper name in this usage.

cautions: The packet supplies the nominal lexical item لَظَىٰ in Mufradat but no corresponding QAC nominal form group; it is therefore listed under other_classical_meanings rather than among the canonical QAC forms.
